decisions.reason: The source changes how keyword and KDP upload assistance will be performed, while this candidate concerns general publication prerequisites and remains valid unchanged.
Guided handling of keywords and KDP uploading does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The source explicitly limits the requested guided workflow to keywords and uploading and does not alter the cover design requirements or unresolved cover choice.
The assistance workflow for keywords and KDP upload does not change the copyright-page publication attribution line.
The source changes only the operating mode for keyword and upload assistance, not manuscript copyediting or proofreading.
Client-operated KDP guidance does not change the paperback format or the established 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The keyword and upload workflow has no necessary effect on chapter-heading typography or Chapter 18 formatting.
The source does not change chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
Changing the keyword and KDP upload assistance mode does not modify the authoritative manuscript content or accepted text edits.
